title: Grafana Cloud Review (2026)
intro: Grafana Cloud is evaluated here as an observability and infrastructure monitoring suite — Grafana Cloud is Grafana Labs’ managed metrics/logs/traces/profiles stack (Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope) plus Grafana. Free includes 10,000 active series, 50 GB logs/traces/profiles, 3 users, 14-day retention. Pro adds a published ~$19/month platform fee, longer retention, and usage rates (commonly $6.50 per 1,000 billable series and $8 per active visualisation user). Enterprise/Advanced is a spend-commit (~$25k/year cited) custom contract. Self-hosted Grafana OSS remains free and is a different buying motion. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Grafana Cloud when managed Grafana/LGTM telemetry is the job — not Datadog host modules and not ITSM.
verdict: Choose Grafana Cloud when managed Grafana/LGTM telemetry is the job — not Datadog host modules and not ITSM. Compare Datadog or New Relic for all-in-one APM suites; PagerDuty for paging. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Grafana UX is familiar to OSS users; Cloud usage meters still need FinOps attention.
Managed observability — cluster peer of Datadog/New Relic, not PagerDuty-only on-call.
Metrics/logs/traces/profiles + dashboards are deep; less ‘single vendor APM suite’ than New Relic.
Huge data-source ecosystem; Cloud is the hosted version of that.
Enterprise SKU carries SAML/audit; Pro is usage-grade.
Usage pricing scales; Enterprise commit for large estates.
Best Free telemetry cap in this wave; Pro is honest usage. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI is not the Grafana Cloud buying reason vs dashboards and telemetry.

Enterprise security (SAML, audit) is not the Free/Pro default story
Running Grafana OSS yourself is a different TCO (people, not SaaS)
